profile.ja: 魔族であったが、対魔忍との戦闘で左腕と両足を失い、魔力が使えなくなってしまった。しかし戦うことも生きることも困難になった彼女に米連の研究者たちが接触、契約を結び、彼らの科学技術で失った両足と左腕、使えなくなった魔力を使えるように補助する機構を身体に仕込む。こうして蘇ったセイロンは前以上の戦力を手に入れ、引き換えに米連の指示で動く暗殺者となった。魔力により駆動するガトリングガンを装備しており、長い柄の先端に装備された丸鋸は、ヨーヨーのように自在に伸縮させて敵を攻撃することができる。彼女を知る者は彼女を改造した研究者と一部の上層部だけであり、その存在は甲河アスカなど米連で活躍する者たちにも隠されている。彼女は任務で数多くの魔族や対魔忍を葬る傍ら、自分を瀕死にまで追い込んだ対魔忍の水城不知火とその背後にいるという淫魔の王を追っている。
profile.en: She was a demon, but after losing her left arm and both legs in a battle against the Taimanin, she also lost the ability to use her magic. However, when she was having trouble fighting and living, researchers from the American union contacted her, made a contract, and installed mechanisms in her body that would allow her to use her lost limbs and magic with the help of their science and technology. This revived Ceylon acquired even greater combat capabilities than before, and in exchange, she became an assassin who moves according to the American union's instructions. She is equipped with a magic-driven Gatling gun, and the circular saw at the end of its long handle can be freely extended and retracted like a yo-yo to attack enemies. Only the researchers who modified her and a few high-ranking officials know of her existence, and her presence is even hidden from those who are active in the American union, such as Koukawa Asuka. While carrying out her missions and burying many demons and Taimanin, she is also pursuing Mizuki Shiranui, the Taimanin who drove her to the brink of death, and the Demon King who is behind her.

text.ja: セイロン。私の名前を聞いた奴は生かしておけねぇな。な～んて、あんたは特別、生かしといたるわ
text.en: My name's Ceylon. Anyone who's heard it is a dead man walking... but you're special, so I'll let you live.

text.ja: 私が殺し屋だって知ってんの？　じゃあ、躊躇なく殺せる、ラッキーやわ！
text.en: You know I'm an assassin, right? Well, that means I can kill you without hesitation - lucky you!

text.ja: 左腕と両脚は米連製の機械よ。それにせんと生きてられんかったしね
text.en: My left arm and both legs are American union-made machines. I wouldn't have been able to survive without them, anyway.

text.ja: この身体をくれたから、米連の犬なんてやっとるんよ。暗殺者の仕事は嫌いじゃないけどね
text.en: Since they gave me this body, I'm doing the American union's dirty work. I don't mind being an assassin, though.

text.ja: 私の存在は、研究者と一部の上層部しか知らんのよ。もし知られたら……ぶっ殺す！
text.en: Only the researchers and a few high-ranking officials know about my existence. If anyone else finds out... I'll kill them!

text.ja: 戦闘好きが仇でこんな身体になったんやけど……戦いはやめられんわ！　くぅ～っ、燃えてきたぁ！
text.en: I got this body because I loved fighting too much... but I just can't stop fighting! Ugh, I'm getting all fired up!

text.ja: 対魔忍と淫魔王って奴、あんた知らん？　知ってるんやったら今すぐゲロせえや！
text.en: You know about the Taimanin and the Demon King? If you do, spit it out right now!

text.ja: 暗殺者に命乞いしても無駄なんよ。最初から殺すって決まってるんやから。抵抗も無駄よ？　あんたはもう死んでっからな
text.en: Don't bother begging for your life as an assassin - it's no use. I've already decided to kill you, so resisting is pointless. You're as good as dead already.

text.ja: あんたもドスケベな口やろ？　じゃあ、変な勘ぐりとか忘れて、朝までしっぽり楽しもうやぁ～
text.en: You've got a dirty mouth, don't you? Well, forget about any weird ideas you might have, and let's enjoy ourselves until morning, shall we?

text.ja: うっわ！　もうバッキバキやん！　ああ、こんなん見たら私も濡れるぅ……。我慢できひん……もう、抱いてぇ！
text.en: Wow, you're really turned on, aren't you? Ah, just looking at you is getting me wet too... I don't think I can hold back anymore... I want you to take me now!
